newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Life, Putnam agree pension fund cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Life, Putnam agree pension fund cooperation.

text.p: Japan's top life insurer Nippon Life Insurance Co said on Thursday that it had signed an agreement on strategic cooperation in pension fund management with Putnam Investments Inc of the United States.
Nippon Life said in a statement that it hoped to meet diverse demands from its customers by offering better services in the asset management business ahead of Japan's financial "Big Bang".

The two firms will cooperate on fund management and research and the development of financial products, Nippon Life said. They will also swap trainees and information about markets and asset-management methods, Nippon Life said.
The two companies will consider the specifics of the cooperation in the future, Nippon Life said.

Nissay Asset Management Corp, a Nippon Life unit, also said on Thursday that it had agreed with Putnam on a business tie-up in which they will cooperate on asset management, the development of financial products and the exchange of information.
